title: Lower color saturation and luxury brand status
statement:
Lower color saturation increases perceived status of luxury brands by signaling continuity heritage and the passage of time.

Options:
- Heritage muted: saturation <30% muted tones (fits: heritage luxury, timeless)
- Balanced prestige: saturation 40-60% moderate (fits: contemporary luxury)
- High-impact saturated: saturation >70% vivid (fits: innovative luxury, campaign accent)
- Quiet luxury: desaturated neutrals + metallic accent (fits: minimalist luxury)
appliesWhen: Applies to: luxury. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Color of Status: Color Saturation, Brand Heritage, and Perceived Status of Luxury Brands
source.authors: Xinyue Zhou; Chunqu Xiao; Sunyee Yoon; Hong Zhu
